title: Grateful Dead Live at Gulfstream Park Race Track on 1968-12-29

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1968 festival set featuring a smoking Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven sequence.
ai_review.review: This recording delivers crystal‑clear vocals and a superb mix that lets Jerry’s blazing guitar work shine throughout the hour‑long set. The band rides a relentless groove, delivering standout performances of Dark Star, St. Stephen, The Eleven, The Other One and Cryptical with high festival energy. Even with occasional vintage saturation, the soundboard source is remarkably listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 4‑5 star reviews praise both the musical performance and the excellent soundboard recording; weighting yields a near‑perfect score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear vocals, crisp mix, sharp guitar tones; occasional period saturation but overall superb fidelity for a 1968 source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A seamless, hour‑long festival set that flows from Lovelight into Dark Star > St. Stephen > The Eleven and onward, maintaining high momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note his guitar is on fire—blazing solos in Dark Star, Eleven and Other One with crisp, sharp tone.
band_member_comments.Bob: Caught joking about the upcoming Dark Star single; no specific performance comment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten (TC) appears innocuous but adds occasional tasteful fills; overall keyboards support the flow.
band_member_comments.Drums: Two‑drummer setup noted by a reviewer who was present, adding power to the high‑energy festival vibe.
